data.description: Build Glory by Heavy Stunning enemies. When you have maximum Glory you may entreat the Ancestors to crush your enemies, manifesting a massive hammer that falls from the sky onto your target, Slamming into the ground after a short duration and dealing immense damage based on your weapon.
stats: Generates 100% of Monster Power as Glory for
this Skill on Heavy Stunning an enemy
While Dual Wielding, both weapons hit with 30% less damage
